step1_analysis.description: A locally bootstrapped symmetrical switch used in a switched-capacitor delta-sigma modulator. It utilizes a bootstrap capacitor (XM7) to maintain a constant gate-source voltage across the main switch (XM3), avoiding gate dielectric overstress and improving linearity for rail-to-rail signals.

paper_reference.title: Very Low-Voltage Digital-Audio Modulator with 88-dB Dynamic Range Using Local Switch Bootstrapping

dynamic_range.description: Dynamic range of the modulator using this switch

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on kT/C noise and switch linearity. Assuming a 1pF sampling cap, SNR = 10*log10((0.4^2/2) / (kT/C)) ~= 80 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 at 1.8V allows larger signal swing than the paper's 1V, potentially improving DR, but it is ultimately limited by thermal noise and switch THD.

power_consumption.description: Power consumption of the switch and its bootstrapping circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = f * C * V^2. With VDD=1.8V instead of 1V, power increases by (1.8/1)^2 = 3.24x. 7uW * 3.24 = 22.6uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher supply voltage in Sky130 leads to increased dynamic power consumption during clock transitions.

sky130_expected.calculation: Switch bandwidth is much higher: (Ron * Cload)^-1. For Ron=1k, Cload=1pF, BW > 100MHz. The 25kHz is the application signal bandwidth.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The switch itself supports much higher frequencies, but the target application is audio (25kHz).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power consumption, transient switching behavior, and AC bandwidth of the bootstrapped switch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bootstrapped Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N4 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VDD N4 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N0 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 N4 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Clocks for switching (100kHz)
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 1.8 pulse(0 1.8 0 1n 1n 5u 10u)
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 1.8 pulse(0 1.8 0 1n 1n 5u 10u)
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 dc 0 pulse(1.8 0 0 1n 1n 5u 10u)

* Input signal (1kHz sine wave)
Vin N2 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.4 1k)
* Load capacitor
Cload N3 0 1p

.control
* === Transient Analysis ===
tran 100n 2m
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power
meas tran v_max max v(N3)
meas tran v_min min v(N3)
* Measure THD to estimate SNDR/Dynamic Range
fourier 1k v(N3)

* === AC Analysis ===
* Force clocks to DC states that keep the switch ON
alter VLABEL_NET_0 dc=0
alter VLABEL_NET_1 dc=0
alter VLABEL_NET_3 dc=0
op
ac dec 10 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N3)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac bw when gain_db=-3 fall=1

print avg_power dc_gain bw
quit
.endc
